Hello List,
=20
I wanted to double check to see if MRDS with point transects was still not =
an option with the latest version. If not, I was wondering when this was =
going to be an option?=20
=20
A related aside: I notice with the Golftees example that the distances for =
each observer are the same. Is this mandatory? or just an artifact of that =
particular dataset?=20
=20
Thanks in advance.
=20
James Martin=20

messages.author: 5140016d70f6ba82
messages.subject: Re: Mark-recapture Distance sampling with point transects
parts:
James Martin wrote:
> > Hello List,
> >
> > I wanted to double check to see if MRDS with point transects was still not an option with the latest version. If not, I was wondering when this was going to be an option?
> >
It is currently not an option but it is something I've been considering
to add in this next year. You can use something like MARK to estimate
a combined g(0) and then use that with point transect distances in
Distance but that only works if you have no covariates for the
mark-recapture data.
> >
> > A related aside: I notice with the Golftees example that the distances for each observer are the same. Is this mandatory? or just an artifact of that particular dataset?
> >
Not an artifact. There is currently no code in Distance that handles
measurement error so all measurements of distance and covariates are
assumed to be without error which by definition means they must be the
same when seen for both observers.

--jeff
